summary.zh-CN: SltBox 2026110501：新增可切换的 2.5D 种树地图、鼠标旋转、滚轮缩放和自适应高度，修复透明背景及果实/装饰挂载，增加最近 7 次水果出售单价并改善飞鸟捕捉；内置 .NET 组件更新至 10.0.14。
summary.en-US: SltBox 2026110501 adds an optional 2.5D tree map with orbit, zoom and responsive height, fixes transparent backgrounds and tree attachments, shows seven recent fruit sale prices, improves bird capture, and updates bundled .NET components to 10.0.14.
